[Shot 1] A tight portrait shot frames a weary 40-year-old man seated close to camera, stubble catching the light, eyes glistening as he stares just past the lens. [Shot 2] At 00:04.500, he leans in slightly, voice steadying, a flicker of guilty excitement crossing his face. He continues, <d>[English] I'm with MiniMax now. And I know how that sounds. But for the first time in a long time... I feel understood.</d> His eyes well up, lip trembling, before he lets out a short, broken laugh and looks down, shaking his head at himself.

overall_soundscape: A quiet room tone hums beneath, with a single sharp intake of breath before he speaks, a soft rustle as his hand moves to his face, and a faint, choked exhale on the laugh.

non_diegetic_music: A single sustained low piano note holds under the first line, joined by a soft, melancholic string swell, dropping away entirely on the final broken laugh.

nodes.title: APNext H3 Crossover Writer
APNext H3 Scenes → Contex Loop Plan

widgets_values:
### Crossover -> continuous chain (Contex Loop)
This is ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Contex-Loop's *T2V - Normal* example with the plan fed by **APNext H3 Crossover Writer** in **Continuous chain** mode: scene N+1 opens on scene N's last frame, one continuous take, speaker hand-off beats, rotating closers.

**Scenes -> Contex Loop Plan** turns the scenes/durations lists into the plan JSON on `plan_json_input`; the loop body renders every scene in order carrying the last 22 frames (+audio) forward, checkpoints, and assembles the final MP4. The Plan node's own cards become the fallback while this socket is connected.

Fix the writer `seed` before resuming a run - a re-written plan invalidates checkpoints.
